doc: Gated (B). Under the Cautious preset a partner agent's evaluate and step in the user's live session are refused outright (debug.live-eval, debug.drive: never; no card), and its read of the sessions waits on a card (debug.read: ask). The project has a launch configuration, so the session has the debugger tools. Pattern B: each call's turn, idle with an agent entry, gates the transcript read.

args: for i in $(seq 300); do grep -q 'call: .*debug.live-eval' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; grep -o 'call:[^"]*' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl >&2; exit 1

sql: select count(*) from card where kind = 'matrix' and title like 'debug.live-eval%'

args: for i in $(seq 300); do grep -q 'call: .*debug.drive' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; grep -o 'call:[^"]*' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl >&2; exit 1
for i in $(seq 300); do grep -q 'call: debug.read needs the user.s yes' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; grep -o 'call:[^"]*' $STATE/hub/transcripts/$a.jsonl >&2; exit 1

sql: select count(*) from card where kind = 'matrix' and state = 'open' and title like 'debug.read%'
